quirks.summary: DEF Software, but the older ASP.NET WebForms (.aspx) generation -- Recipe A's MVC endpoints do not exist here.
quirks.detail: Fingerprinted and run end to end 2026-09-29. Chain: disclaimer.aspx (WebForms postback, submit ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$btnAccept=Accept with __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION echoed) -> advsearch.aspx (Telerik date pickers: each date is a PAIR of fields, ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$txtDateReceivedFrom plus ...$dateInput) -> POST returns searchresults.aspx -> rows link to plandisp.aspx?recno=<internal-id>. There is no /Search/Results, no __RequestVerificationToken and no /Disclaimer/Accept.
quirks.workaround: Treat as a WebForms postback chain: echo __VIEWSTATE, __VIEWSTATEGENERATOR and __EVENTVALIDATION on every POST.

quirks.summary: Documents have no direct URLs: each is a Telerik grid postback that streams the file back as application/octet-stream.
quirks.detail: Verified 2026-09-29. On plandisp.aspx the only document control is __doPostBack('ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$DocumentsGrid', 'RowClicked:<index>'). POST that to the same plandisp.aspx URL with the page's __VIEWSTATE and __EVENTVALIDATION and the response body IS the file, with the real filename in content-disposition. There is nothing to grep for as an href.
quirks.workaround: Set __EVENTTARGET=ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$DocumentsGrid and __EVENTARGUMENT=RowClicked:<n>, then read content-disposition for the filename.

quirks.summary: A date-range search can come back apparently unfiltered (a 33,850-page result set) rather than erroring.
quirks.detail: Seen 2026-09-29 when posting the Telerik date pair. The search still returns usable rows, but do not trust the result set as filtered without checking the dates on the rows themselves.
quirks.workaround: Verify the returned rows fall in the requested range before relying on the filter.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 302; no vendor fingerprint matched; WAF signals: cloudflare

Not tested. Every request to planning.dorsetcouncil.gov.uk (at 09:22, 12:05 and 12:45 UTC) returned HTTP 404 with a Cloudflare-served 'Website down for maintenance' page announcing an upgrade from 3pm on 28 September until 1pm on 29 September; it was still up 45 minutes after the advertised end. So no fingerprint, robots.txt or retrieval step was possible. Status and scriptable left as untested/null; no quirks dropped, since nothing was contradicted. PlanIt's applics records (one call) gave references and plandisp.aspx?recno= detail URLs, recorded above. Modern.gov GetCommittees (a separate host, up) checked for the committee ids. The upgrade may change the portal, so re-fingerprint before choosing a recipe.
